project_type: Python Django REST Framework API starter within a multi-starter monorepo
build_system: uv for package management, Django manage.py for project commands
test_framework: pytest with pytest-django and Hypothesis for property-based testing
build_command: cd django-api-backend && uv sync && uv run python manage.py check && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest
verification_instructions: 1. cd django-api-backend; 2. uv sync; 3. uv run ruff check .; 4. uv run ruff format --check .; 5. uv run mypy .; 6. uv run python manage.py check; 7. uv run pytest; 8. docker build -t django-api-backend:test .
setup_instructions: 1. cd django-api-backend; 2. uv sync (installs all deps from uv.lock); 3. cp .env.example .env (adjust as needed); 4. uv run python manage.py migrate; 5. uv run python manage.py runserver
environment_constraints: uv 0.11.32 available, Python 3.12 available via uv, Docker available. Internet access for pip/uv installs.
contribution_requirements: Each starter must be fully standalone - no imports from root or other starters. Must have starter.json matching catalog entry. Must include pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .env.example, README.md, Dockerfile, tests.
key_patterns: Starters use a project-local starter.json with immutable identity fields matching catalog/starters.json. Provider adapters behind local interfaces with fake/test defaults. Stable error shapes. Correlation IDs in logs/errors. Rate limiting. OpenAPI for all endpoints. Container + local startup. Ephemeral DB for restart tests.
directory_structure: Repository root contains catalog/, scripts/, tests/, .github/workflows/, and starter folders. Each starter is a self-contained project. django-api-backend/ will follow: src/<modules>/ with transport/application/domain/infrastructure layers, migrations/, openapi/, tests/, Dockerfile, .env.example, starter.json, README.md, pyproject.toml, uv.lock
